name: Computer Science
notes: Encodes the UPDATED BA requirements (students matriculating fall 2026 and beyond). Students who matriculated earlier follow the retiring requirements: two core courses from the six-course core list plus seven electives.
Pre-major courses require a GPA no lower than 2.0.

Elective restrictions not auto-checked: no more than one elective below CSC 171; CSC 161/162 only count if taken before CSC 171/172 (and without AP credit for 171); at most two independent studies (39x).
No more than two core or major electives at other institutions (except UR education abroad).
Clusters: one humanities and one social sciences, passed with a 2.0 average or better.

requirementGroups.label: Pre-major
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: must first complete the following pre-major requirements with a GPA no lower than a 2.0: CSC 171, MATH 150, CSC 172

requirementGroups.label: Core: theory (one of CSC 173 / 280)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: At least one course must be selected from: CSC 173: Computation and Formal Systems; CSC 280: Computer Models and Limitations

requirementGroups.label: Core: systems (one of CSC 252 / 254)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: At least one course must be selected from: CSC 252: Computer Organization; CSC 254: Programming Language Design and Implementation

requirementGroups.label: Core: third course
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: The third course can be chosen from the four core courses above and: CSC 242: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence; CSC 282: Design and Analysis of Efficient Algorithms

requirementGroups.label: CS major electives (6)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students must also complete six (6) computer science major electives. This is any four-credit computer science course subject to the following restrictions
requirementGroups.note: Restrictions on sub-171 courses, CSC 161/162 timing, and independent-study counts are listed in the program notes and not auto-enforced.

upperLevelWriting.label: Two upper-level writing courses (department-preapproved list)
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: The following courses are preapproved for satisfying this requirement: WRTG 273 ... CSC 273W ... PHIL 257W
